 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Pankaj Kumar Singh, Advocate  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Humayou Ahmad Khan, APP  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PARTHA SARTHY  ORAL ORDER 2 16-08-2023 1.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.P.P. for the State.

2. The petitioner has preferred this application for grant of anticipatory bail apprehending his arrest in connection with Complaint Case no. 1423C of 2019, registered under section 498A of the Indian Penal Code.
3. As per the prosecution case, the complainant was married to the petitioner in June, 2018.
It is stated that the accused persons including the petitioner herein started to torture the complainant for demand of dowry which was to the tune of Rs.1 lakh in cash and a motorcycle.
They used to abuse, assault Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.48970 of 2023(2) dt.16-08-2023 as also physically and mentally torture the complainant.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has been falsely implicated in the Abhishek Das @ Abhishek Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 16 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/108213792/
1 case only on account of his being the husband of the complainant.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The allegations besides being general and omnibus are false and concocted.
The petitioner has always been ready to keep the complainant ie his wife with full honour and dignity.

Learned counsel further referring to the order of the learned trial Court submits that the learned Court below has categorically noted the submission made on behalf of the petitioner that he was ready to keep the complainant wife with full dignity and honour but the learned lawyer for the complainant submitted that the complainant is not ready to live with the petitioner on account of his sexual orientation.
5. Heard learned A.P.P. for the State.
6. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and taking into consideration the nature of allegation against the petitioner in the complaint petition together with the contents of the order of the learned trial Court as also the petitioner not having any criminal antecedent, it is directed that the petitioner, above named, in the event of his arrest or surrender before the Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.48970 of 2023(2) dt.16-08-2023 learned Court below within a period of four weeks, be released on anticipatory bail in connection with Complaint Case no. 1423C of 2019 on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Begusarai.

(Partha Sarthy, J) Shiv/-
